title: Ziplock bag organizer w/cutters to hang on a wall or put in a super large drawer but...
text:
Ziplock bag organizer w/cutters to hang on a wall or put in a super large drawer but.... This is a six-compartment organizer with two compartments for a roll of plastic wrap or foil with a cutter and four other compartments for different types of Ziplock bags (quart, gallon, sandwich, and snack). Since the labels are etched into the bamboo, the cutter compartments cannot be used for wax paper unless one does not mind it being mislabeled. The cutter strips are already installed for the rolls. The cutting strips cut well but one of them arrived with some gunk on it (see photo).

The unit opens via hinge and this is both good and bad. If installing this on a wall, the bags will fall out when changing a roll, so it has to be taken off the wall. Also, both rolls will have to be fed through the holes again when changing just one roll. I think this is more suited to a drawer. I wish the rolls had their own compartment. Some organizers actually have a hole in the side to insert a roll of wax paper, foil, or plastic wrap.

Two screws with plastic mollies are provided for hanging. I am actually surprised that there are not three holes on the back. Most organizers that are this heavy have three holes for hanging. In addition, rubberized circles are provided for the bottom. Rubberized circles prevent the bamboo from scratching a wall or drawer and keep it from sliding around in a drawer.

Overall, this is an excellent organizer that does away with all those squished and ugly boxes in my cabinets. It is definitely a quality unit but best used in a drawer or removed from the wall for filling because all the bags will fall out otherwise. Of course, I do not like the gunk on one of the cutters that might be from the Styrofoam packaging.

The current price of $30.60 ($34 minus 10%) is on the low side of competitively priced for this. There are many other Ziplock bag organizer options available on the market such as this [[ASIN:B09KMNHM2J one]] or this [[ASIN:B09VGP1WRL one]]. For one full unit only, then I recommend this [[ASIN:B09RF759BM rustic organizer]]. For a more modern look, I recommend this [[ASIN:B09WN5PZ6Q one]] or an individual heavy plastic set like [[ASIN:B09THNTBGX this]]. For a cheaper unit that has room for foil and plastic wrap, then I highly recommend this [[ASIN:B0B1TPD21S one]] but no screws are provided with that one. I tried all of these and the style purchased is based on what one desires.
